text:
Maya (CS Ops): Heads-up: Q2 enablement spike. Proposal: run a 2-week "enable sprint" with 3-day workshop clusters + daily 1hr office-hours. Need a simple on-call/trainer handoff and an urgent-flag flow for renewal-risk accounts.

Ethan (CSM): Love the sprint idea. For renewals, can we have a single-click flag that escalates to next available trainer? We need an audit row in the sheet for follow-up.

Rafa (Enablement): I can build the public sprint calendar and a calendar invite template. Suggestion: office-hours slots: 09:00-10:00UTC, 14:00-15:00UTC, 22:00-23:00UTC to cover NA/EU/APAC.

Jordan (Trainer): 2-week blocks work for me. I prefer pairing week 2 for shadowing. Also can swap if someone needs APAC-heavy coverage.

Maya (CS Ops): For the urgent flag, I'm thinking a short Airtable form with columns: account, health score, trigger (renewal/migration/onboarding), preferred windows, immediate blocker, requested SLA. The form should create a row and ping #enablement-ops.

Ethan (CSM): SLA proposal: ack within 12h, confirm slot within 48h for renewal-risk. Non-renewal urgent tickets get ack in 24h, slot within 72h.

Rafa (Enablement): I'll wire cs-bot to create a draft invite when reaction :flag-enable: is used and to ping the on-call trainer. Command sample for pool: `@cs-bot set-sprint-pool Rafa,Jordan,Asa,Lina`.

cs-bot: I can: 1) create draft invites on :flag-enable:, 2) rotate on-call in order, 3) post weekly summary if you run `@cs-bot sprint-summary`. Use `@cs-bot set-sprint-pool NAME,NAME,...` to configure.

Jordan (Trainer): Can we add a quick poll to customers for preferred windows? I can take the APAC mornings if needed.

Lina (Customer): From the account side, mornings APAC (08:30-10:30 local) work best. Happy to take a 3-question pref poll.

Maya (CS Ops): Next steps: 1) Rafa publishes calendar + invite template by tomorrow noon. 2) I build the Airtable triage form and sheet columns. 3) Ethan documents SLA and signs off with CS leadership. 4) Rafa configures cs-bot pool after we finalize list. 5) Jordan starts the customer poll for his cohort.

Ethan (CSM): I'll add a one-line summary we can paste into renewal notes.

Rafa (Enablement): Runbook snippet I'll add to #docs:```
Airtable fields: account, cs_owner, health_score, trigger, pref_windows, blocker, urgency_level
cs-bot commands:
@cs-bot set-sprint-pool Rafa,Jordan,Asa,Lina
React +:flag-enable: to create draft invite and ping on-call
```

Maya (CS Ops): If anyone needs to drop their block, post here with a preferred replacement and tag :swap:. We'll track swaps in the sprint sheet. Thanks all. :rocket:
